notes.title: Easter Update - They have Risen (2.0.0)
notes.content:
Wishing you all a happy belated Easter! 

We hope you had a fantastic day filled with joy and celebration. We would like to express our gratitude for your continued support and feedback, which has helped us to improve our game and deliver the best possible gaming experience for our players.

We are excited to announce a major update that addresses numerous issues that have been reported since the game's launch. Along with the bug fixes, we have added multiple features, weapons, and environments to enhance your gaming experience.

We would like to give a special shout-out to @Syagrius for providing invaluable feedback and support throughout the development process. The game wouldn't be where it is today without their help.

We apologize for the delay in this announcement, as we were busy working on a new trailer. We would love to hear your thoughts on it, so please don't hesitate to share your feedback with us. Thank you again for your support, and we look forward to seeing you in-game!

A full list of the changes can be found below:

[h1]TODO[/h1]

	- Add a drop animation for Luna's Final Stand.
	- Tutorial messages should change based on game modes or nearby items.
	- Add biomass to the other maps.
	- Change projectile FX.
	- Let player use their build menu button to close the building menu.
	- Make zombies a little more variable in their movement and abilities (I.E. leaping, dodging, etc...)
	- Add a tooltip to the optimized lobby option that explains that it removes everything but a light and a cube.
	- Find a way to enable RTX and Lumen by graphics option instead of forcing it on all the time.
		
[h1]KNOWN ISSUES[/h1]
	
	- Player has to hit a button twice sometimes in the menu to move to another screen.
	- Somtimes audio settings don't apply to the game.
	- Chat menu still shows up in singleplayer mode when changing a character in the lobby.
	
[h1]CHANGELOG[/h1] (2.0.0:04/09/23)

	[h2]ADDITIONS[/h2]
		- Added a new map Ares Station (beta).
                - Added a new menu to report mistranslations.
		- Added a secret way to escape in Endless game modes.
		- Added a new assault rifle (AR-48).
		- Added a new shotgun (Devastator).
		- Added a new burst rifle (BR-12).
		- Added a crossbow.
		- Added an intro screen.
		- Added a EULA that is visible on your first playthrough.
		- Added an epilepsy warning.
		- Added a roam function for when zombies don't have any targets.
		- Added ammo box and perk modules to the tutorial.
		- Added a battle arena where the player can fight against endless bosses.
		- Added steam controller support.
		- Added a rarity system for random weapons in the weapon box and the random weapon abilities.
		- Added a psy blade that does massive damage.
		- Added a tournament system where the player fights a series of bosses for points then returns to the start area when they are dead.
		- Added a new gun named Voidray that does insane damage.
		- Added localizations for 28 different languages as well as a menu to change the selected language.
		- Added a system where the zombie can grab the player and bite them to death.
		- Added a codex.
		- Added an status icon for the Inquisitor perk.
		- Added a melee attack for the scanner.
		- Added a new perk to reduce ability cooldown by 50%
		- Added better bloody explosion FX when zombies explode.
		- Added a new perk (Iquisitor) that cuts your cooldown times in half.
		- Added text to the build menu top bar icons.	
		- Added a tooltip widget to show build requirements for buildings in LFS game mode.
		- Added advanced blood splatters.
		- Added a function that lets some doors in the Science Lab open when you walk by.
		- Added a zombie kill volume for zombies that clip outside of the Science Lab.
		- Added a second sun to Hell's dungeon to help with the super dark walls.
		- Added notifications to give better info on destroying towers in Devil's Towers.
		- Added notifications to give better info to explain to stay within the safe zone in Death To The Heretics!
		- Added a flashlight for "Dark Maps".
		- Added a marker to help players find zombies if the round goes on for too long.

	[h2]CHANGES[/h2]
		- Improved FPS look and feel.
		- Changed lighting for some maps to amplify the horror element of the game.
		- Reduced the amount of metal given in a supply drop.
		- Updated ability icons.
		- Increased zombie movement speeds.
		- Increased shotgun range.
		- Changed barrier and trap animations.
		- Reduced lighting in Cosmic Infection and Underground Facility and added a flashlight that is always on in those maps.
		- Preventing damage to player in shooting range.
		- Interaction and ability animations now move to the third person camera.
		- Updated reloading sounds.
		- Changed some abilities to better match characters.
		- Player can close the pause menu with the escape or keys now.
		- Increased corpse lifespan.
		- Added a text to display the current game mode for the map.
		- If weapon is at max upgrade level description just says weapon at max level.
		- Zombies now explode into a bloody explosion when hit by explosive projectiles.
		- Zombies won't spawn mini's if hit by explosive damage.
		- We blocked the button that let's the player restart the level in the tutorial.
		- Reduced enemy tower damage in the Devil's Tower game mode.
		- Increased ammo for the RG-AR
		- Increased the slope angle that zombies can walk at.
		- Changed barrier models and door models so they look better.
		- Zombies don't add cash when killed in the tutorial.
		- Increased interaction range for the weapon stands.
		- Removed some of the hotkey text from the building HUD.
		- Blocked building near the base in Death To The Heretics!
		- Dungeons are built asynchronously now so the screen doesn't freeze.
		- Blocked players from jumping up entry door barriers in Science Lab
		- Decreased interact size for Health Upgrade and Slight of Hand upgrade in Science Lab
		- Hid chat message in single player.
		- Hid kick player button if in singleplayer.

	[h2]FIXES[/h2]
		- Fixed an issue where powerups can block zombie movement.
		- Fixed lighting in Cosmic infection map.
		- Fixed an issue that prevented player from building ramps in LFS game modes.
		- Fixed an issue when player will get put in to a spectator mode in singleplayer when falling through the Void in the Hell's Dungeon game mode.
		- Fixed an issue where player upgrade levels are overwritten when switching weapons.
		- Fixed the barrier position for Abbadon's barrier.
		- Fixed an issue where waves can end when there are still zombies alive that weren't summoned by another zombie.
		- Fixed lighting in the Underground Facility.
		- Fixed issue in Science Lab map where some zombies get stuck on the railing instead of jumping down.
		- Fixed issue where zombies don't follow the player when they are standing on top of the modules.
		- Fixed issue where turrets can't shoot zombies when they are crawling.
		- Fixed an issue where reload sounds played twice.
		- Fixed an issue where sometimes zombies walk to the exact same spot which can look weird when they stack up.
		- Fixed an issue where players were spawning with zero ammo in multiplayer.
		- Fixed an issue where players were not able to see their abilities in multiplayer.
		- Fixed an issue where the game froze when selecting their options menu.
		- Fixed an issue where the host was seeing a spectating screen when they were still alive in multiplayer.
		- Fixed an issue where player takes damage at 24 seconds with certain ultimate abilities each and every time.
		- Fixed stair collisions in Science Lab.
		- Fixed an issue where mines don't always blow up in LFS game mode.
		- Fixed an issue where mining metal does not do anything (add an interaction animation).
		- Fixed an issue where built turrets don't do anything in LFS
		- Fixed an issue where interaction with Mines and Supply Drops can be a little tricky.
		- Fixed an issue where zombies can clip in between walls in the Research Lab start area spawns.
		- Fixed an issue where zombie can get stuck in Research Lab behind the bench.
		- Fixed an issue with player ranking not being displayed properly.
		- Fixed issues with zombie projectiles clipping through walls and hitting players.
		- Fixed issues with modules not activating in certain cases.
		- Fixed the -1 Waves survived text in the Devil's Towers game mode.
		- Fixed busted materials in the Death To The Heretics game mode.
		- Fixed broken teleporters.
		- Fixed issue where flashlight shadows were really weird when looking at certain areas.
		- Fixed an issue where zombies could clip in to the railings in the Science Lab.
		- Fixed an issue where Zombies can clip into stairs in ScienceLab map
		- Fixed an issue where zombies would get stuck in the tree in the center of the Research Facility.
		- Fixed an issue that showed an error message when placed field mines exploded.
		- Fixed broken module upgrade in the Research Facility.
		- Fixed an issue where the player would get stuck in the teleporter if they died in the tutorial.
		- Fixed an issue where zombies wouldn't move in the tutorial.
		- B2023-02-05, Cosmic infection: It is like my shadow is in front of me instead of being behind me. Bug it may be. (Fixed)
		- B2023-02-05, Cosmic infection: Some seals have a double little seal. Is it intended? (Fixed)
		- B2023-02-05, Cosmic infection: Room here without access to the area. Like an invisible wall. Seal missing? Good night! (Fixed)
		- B2023-02-09,Tutorial: If the ship transition works, this message will have to be changed a bit to include the ship transition possibility. (Fixed)
		- B2023-02-09,Cosmic Infection: I have summun with ability the HK-42 gun. The flashlight feature is not triggered in the dark with this gun. (Fixed)

notes.title: Happy New Year! (Version 1.9.1)
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We just added a few fixes for some reported issues as we get closer to the 2.0.0 update. Here is the changelog! Thank you to everyone who has sent feedback! We hope everyone had a Happy New Year!
	
[h1]CHANGELOG[/h1]

	[h2]ADDITIONS[/h2]
		+ Added a brightness setting to the video options.
		+ Added Voice chat with push to talk (beta).
		+ Added a motion tracker like they have in the movie aliens.
		+ Added blood splatter fx.
		
	[h2]CHANGES[/h2]
		+ Upgraded to Unreal Engine 5.1.
		+ Changed trap VFX.
		+ The game now starts in Fullscreen mode instead of borderless Window mode.
		+ Changed the Keybindings menu so it's easier to use.
		+ Made trap more reliable so it kills every enemy that walks through.
		+ Turrets now rotate to the enemy before shooting.
		+ Remapped default ability keys to Q/E.
		+ Blocked chat menu in single player, but not in tutorial.
		+ Player's selected map and character class are now saved in main menu.
		+ Improved lighting in the Research Lab hallway after the first door.
		+ Added a note to the keybindings menu that let's player know they need to press and hold the left mouse button to change keybindings.
		+ Make the KF-44 lens easier to see through
		+ Improved lighting in Cosmic Infection.
		+ Changed the model for the Reaver boss.
		+ Updated button images so the rounded boxes are gone.
		+ Updated models to use nanite.
		+ Changed the Blink description to make more sense.
		+ Added text over the ability icons so it's easier to understand what they do.
		+ Updated UI colors.
		+ Updated Turret so it looks a little more realisitc.
		
	[h2]FIXES[/h2]
		+ Fixed an issue that preventing the player from closing the chat menu.
		+ Fixed an issue where enemies got stuck on railing in research center beginning.
		+ Fixed an issue where the player could not loot the skeletons in the Hell's Dungeon game mode.
		+ Fixed an issue where the mouse cursor would not show up when interacting with inventory actors.
		+ Fixed an issue where the Cosmic Infection turret was not working
		+ Testing a fix that prevents players from walking through the initial zombie barriers in the Science lab.
		+ Testing fix for enemies getting stuck in walls in the science map area.
		+ Testing a fix for enemies getting stuck in cosmic infection hallway.
		+ Fixed some issues where abilities weren't rotating to the player's facing direction.

notes.title: Update Version 1.9.0
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

This update addresses a lot of the issues reported in the discussions. Let me know what you think!

[h1]TODO[/h1] 

	- Add more free maps to the game.
	- Improve FPS animations.
	- Improve FPS look and feel.
	- Look in to adding a motion tracker like they have in the movie aliens.
	- Add a drop animation for Luna's Final Stand.

[h1]KNOWN ISSUES[/h1]

	- Ability icons don't have great correlation with the abilities.
	- Interaction is a little buggy on keyboards.
	
[h1]CHANGELOG[/h1]

	[h2]ADDITIONS[/h2]
		- Added a small tooltip in the lobby that shows players helpful tips like what Cash and Rank are for.

	[h2]CHANGES[/h2]
		- Allowing players to save their selected character in the lobby.
		- Removed duplicate textures and models to cut down on the build size.
		- Optimzations for performance.
		- Updated the zombie and boss models.

	[h2]FIXES[/h2]
		- Fixed damage not working when zombies attack the base in DTTH game mode.
		- Fixed zombies spawning underground in DTTH game mode.
		- Fixed enemies still getting stuck between walls in Underground Facility Map
		- Fixed AI that can't move between shelves in the Underground Facility Map.
		- Fixed issue where some users experienced a missing executable error. Uninstalling and reinstalling the game will resolve this.
		- Fixed issue where supply drops would spawn after the player teleported in DTTH game mode.
		- Fixed an issue with the teleporter not taking players to the secret area.
		- Testing fix that doesn't pause game in single player mode.
		- Testing fix for Hell's Dungeon map that takes forever to load.
		- Testing fix for enemies that don't follow players in to certain sections in Cosmic Infection
		- Testing fix for mouse not working after changing settings.
		- Testing fix for keybindings that are a little buggy when selecting a new key.

notes.title: 1.8.0 (Unreal Engine 5 Update)
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

I'm sorry for the delay between these last two updates. We just upgraded from Unreal Engine 4.27 to Unreal Engine 5.1.0. This means that this update is going to be pretty large. 

A lot changed with the engine update (as far as diffs are concerned) so it was pretty hard to reduce the update size. I am still working on creating a new patching system to reduce update sizes for you all, but this one was hard to get around.

Please continue to post your feedback in the discussions or reviews. I am enjoying everything you all have to say about the game, both positive and negative feedback is good! Thank you all so much for playing. We just crossed 10K downloads which is a huge milestone for me. None of my games have received this much attention and it feels amazing to see so many people playing something that I made! =]

[h1]TODO[/h1]

	- Add more free maps to the game.
	- Run a new optimization pass.
	- Remove duplicate textures and models to cut down on the build size.
	- Improve FPS animations.
	- Improve FPS look and feel.
	- Look in to adding a motion tracker like they have in the movie aliens.
	- Add a drop animation for Luna's Final Stand.
			- Player's start in a drop ship.
			- They are sitting in the monk stance.
			- After they stand up they sprint to the dropship and jump out.
			- When they hit the ground they play the flying animation land animation and a huge explosion plays.
			- There should be zombies in the start area for them to eliminate.

[h1]KNOWN ISSUES[/h1]

	- Key bindings are a little buggy when selecting a new key.
	- Enemies don't follow players in to certain sections in Cosmic Infection
	- Allow players to save their selected character in the lobby.
	- Ability icons don't have great correlation with the abilities.
	- Some users experience a missing executable error. Uninstalling and reinstalling the game will resolve this.
	- Hell's Dungeon map takes forever to load.
		- Player spawns a bunch of zombies in the area when they spawn in.

[h1]CHANGELOG[/h1]

	[h2]ADDITIONS[/h2]

		- Added a loading screen to the entry level.
		- Added a sound for when doors and barriers are cleared.
		- Added a separate actor for ammo resupply that gives max ammo for 1,500 credits.
		- Added a function to stop gameplay when the pause menu is opened in Singleplayer.
		- Added a knife for when players are out of ammo
		- Added swords and axes as upgrades over the knife.
		- Added a timer to show how long there is between waves.
		- Added scavenging outside of the safe zone in Death To The Heretics.
		- Added a way to upgrade and expand the safe zone in Death To The Heretics.
		- Added supply drops to Death To The Heretics game modes.
		- Added field mines to Luna's Final Stand and Death To The Heretics game modes.
		- Added building mode Death To The Heretics game mode.
		- Added scavenging to Luna's Final Stand.
		- Added activation animations to abilities.

	[h2]CHANGES[/h2]
	
		- Changed the Supply Drop in Luna's Final stand from 1,500 metal to 5,000 metal.
		- Updated lighting to be a little bit brighter on Cosmic Infection.
		- Made the starting base destructible in Luna's Final Stand.
		- Improved Knife damage and range.
		- Reduced interaction time for weapon upgrade terminal.
		- Reduced the time it takes to fix a barrier after interacting with it.
		- Upgraded to Unreal Engine 5.0.2!
		- Increased time between rounds in Death To The Heretics and Luna's Final Stand.
		- Made material for safe zone two sided in Death To The Heretics.
		- Replaced turrets in Death to The Heretics with buildable turrets.
		- Made turrets repairable in The Devil's Towers.
		- Improved FPS FOV and look and feel with Panini Projection.
		- Changed Nemo's Ult to a massive shockwave. 
		- Turret rotation does not reset it's rotation after it fires at it's target anymore.
		- Towers in The Devils' Tower regardless of the amount of zombies that attack the towers.
		- Vira's tactical nuke should kills all enemies in the map.
		- Removed Switch Floor hotkey display for building HUD.
		- Switched crouch key to left ctrl.
		- Gave RG-BR more ammo.
		- Increased Nemo's Ult cooldown.
		- Removed the debug panel key.

	[h2]FIXES[/h2]
		
		- Fixed a bug where cash doesn't show up properly in the single player section.
		- Fixed an issue with the building system that prevented normal foundations from being placed on the landscape.
		- Fixed an issue with the building system that did not update the UI when collecting resources.
		- Fixed an issue with the building system that destroyed foundations upon placement.
		- Fixed an issue that prevented AI from spawning in Luna's Final Stand.
		- Fixed an issue that prevented the UI from updating when new building resources were collected.
		- Fixed TPS Hand IK.
		- Fixed Shell's Ghost ability.
		- Fixed Vira's name plate offset.
		- Fixed Vira's arm offset.
		- Fixed text wrapping for character display.
		- Fixed Reaver's animations.
		- Fixed name widget location.
		- Fixed an issue that made some instances prevent the achievement counter from incrementing, preventing user from accessing second level achievements.
		- Testing fix for AI still walking away in certain areas like corners.
		- Testing fix that resolves the issue where looking around while running can glitch the camera.
		- Testing fix for green weapon upgrade teleporter that does not teleport player to start.
		- Testing fix for zombies getting stuck in some areas.

notes.title: Update (Version 1.7.0)
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I'm sorry for the delay, but I have a new update ready that should resolve a lot of issues with the game. I will be having another update out shortly.

[u][b]PLEASE NOTE: If you are experiencing an issue that states the executable for the game is missing, you will have to uninstall and reinstall the game. I'm not sure why this happened, but that is the known fix for the issue.[/b][/u]

[h1]TODO[/h1]

	- Add more free maps to the game.
	- Remove any duplicate textures and models to cut down on the build size.

[h1]KNOWN ISSUES[/h1]

	- Keybindings are a little buggy when selecting a new key.
	- Looking around while running can glitch the camera.
	- AI still walk away in certain areas like corners.
	- Ability icons don't have great correlation with the abilities.
	- Some users experience a missing executable error. Uninstalling and reinstalling the game will resolve this.
	- Some instances prevents the achievement counter from incrementing, preventing user from accessing second level achievements.
	- Green weapon upgrade teleporter does not teleport player to start.

[h1]CHANGELOG[/h1]

	[h2]ADDITIONS[/h2]
	
		- Added a building system for the new game mode Luna's Final Stand.
		- Added the map for the Luna's Final Stand game mode.
		- Added the Luna's Final Stand game mode.
		- Added a timer that shows how much time player has left in upgrade area.
		- Added a public beta branch.

	[h2]CHANGES[/h2]

		- Players now get 750 credits for repairing a barrier.
		- Changed the price for the teleporter to the upgrade area in the Research Center so it costs 1,500 credits.
		- Removed the random spaceboxes to cut 3.5 GB out of the build size. The game only uses one space box now.

	[h2]FIXES[/h2]
		
		- Fixed an issue where barriers weren't fixed when player interacts with them.
		- Fixed issue where zombies don't seem to chase player in research center after player progresses through the level.
		- Fixed issue where all zombies would attack the defense area in Death To The Heretics!
		- Fixed an issue that caused the achievement notifcation to pop up too frequently.
		- Fixed weird ADS with some guns.
		- Fixed issue where A.I. would stop moving after round 2.
		- Fixed the issue that prevented the insta buy ability from working.
		- Fixed an issue that displayed the wrong values for the ranking system.
		- Testing fix when upgrading a gun, the gun's max magazine/ammo does not stay above the original count when reloading or buying ammo from wall, only from max ammo upgrade pickup.
		- Testing fix when strafing with a gun can sometimes make the animation of the gun weird.
		- Testing fix for motion blur toggle.

notes.title: Update (Version 1.5.0)
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

 I messed up the versioning number of the last update so this is officially version 1.5.0. 

This update was mainly focused on bug fixes, but it also adds support for the Devil's Towers and Death To The Heretics DLCs. Please note that there is an anti-piracy check built into the game so if you are experiencing a message that says "Yarr there be pirates in yer group!" it means that you are using pirated content. Please make sure that you only purchase DLC from Steam. I haven't added the content to any other store fronts so if you are getting it from some other place it won't work.

		- Fixed the issue where Death to the Heretics! had the wrong game mode.

		- Fixed issue that sent player back to main menu when selecting the "Range" option.

notes.title: Update (Version 1.2.0)
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

This is another big update. I added a lot of new materials, textures, and features that will change the gameplay. This did increase the file size of the game by a lot, but I am preparing to add a few new game modes and maps to the game. The game released as a wave shooter, but like most of my games, I like to add a few things to give you some variety in the different types of game modes you can play. I also addressed a few of the bugs that have been reported. There are still some known issues, but I will be addressing those in the next couple of days! 

Thank you for all of your feedback and support! You will find a list of changes below.

[h1]TODO:[/h1]

	- Weapon upgrades should improve accuracy and increase max ammo/mag ammo.
	- Add all planned weapons to the game.
	- Unlock weapon attachments based on weapon level.

[h1]KNOWN ISSUES:[/h1]

	- Enemies might walk away in certain areas.
	- Aiming while moving can throw off the scope.
        - The in-game chat box can still be a little wonky.

[h1]CHANGELOG:[/h1]

[h2]	ADDITIONS:[/h2]

		- Added a close box that you can click to close the chat box when it is opened.
		- Added more randomization with enemies sounds.
		- Added two new stages to the tutorial to explain the ability system.
		- Added a loadout system. (This requires the Character Editor DLC).
		- Added player abilities (BETA). (Changing your character requires the Character Editor DLC).
		- Added a player currency system and ranking system (BETA).
		- Added a method to take you to DLC pages if the corresponding DLC is not owned.
		- Added a 3D character selection menu to replace the character images.
	
[h2]	CHANGES:[/h2]
	
		- Character editor characters now have unique stats/abilities.
		- Made sounds like jumping and damage voices play only on the local client.
		- Nerfed the pump shotgun.
		- Reduced interaction times for some items.
		- Reduced enemy health so they scale better in the later rounds.

[h2]	FIXES:[/h2]
	
		- Fixed some issues with the ADS system.
		- Fixed some issues where certain sights were off when aiming down sights.
		- Fixed the pump shotguns attachments that didn't show up, making the scope invisible.
		- Fixed an issue where some animations wouldn't play when interacting with an item.
		- Fixed the blurry sight glass on KF-44 (let me know if there are any more that need fixed).
		- Fixed the burning effect that didn't show up when burning.
		- Fixed the delay between zombies spawning and them crawling out of the floor. This made it seem like they were sliding on their bellies when chasing you for the first few seconds.

notes.title: Another quick patch
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

This update should address the issue with the music not adjusting properly to the volume setting in the main menu. 

I've also adjusted the zombie health scalars so they are a little easier to kill in the later rounds. 

There's also a quick fix that sometimes prevented players from spawning in on round 1. 

Finally, I've reduced the chance of advanced zombie spawns. This should pit you against more of the common zombies that are easier to kill rather than throwing you in the deep end against some of the more hardcore zombies.
